summary: Smoke tested removal of Pool Register button/panel and addition of pool-address-warning. App boots clean, all 6 nav tabs render, backend /api/status /api/pubkey /api/ledger all 200 OK. Pool tab renders WALLET + WHAT STAYS VISIBLE panels in no-wallet state. pool-register-panel and pool-register-btn are absent from DOM as intended. pool-address-warning is hidden without connected wallet (expected, gated by connected && sepolia).
critical_code_review_comments: registerInPool() in starknetWallet.js and register export in StarknetProvider.jsx are now dead code — safe to keep for future use as documented, but consider removing if not planned.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pool tab in no-wallet state verified. Warning panel (pool-address-warning) is only visible when wallet connected on Sepolia AND configured pool matches mainnet address — cannot be tested in sandbox without a wallet. Consider manual verification with Ready wallet on Sepolia.
